subject.title: feat(android): server-backed session search with offline fallback

question: Should maintainers accept this Android Sessions search UI as the Android implementation for the session-management tracker after the search-result defects and real Android proof are addressed?
rationale: The PR adds user-facing native Android feature surface under a protected label, and automation cannot decide product acceptance or waive the real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Review After Fixes And Proof

options.title: Defer Android Search
